name: Crop Circle
summary: An avatar upload that frames your real photo in a crop circle, lifts the cut-out and uploads it
about: Crop Circle is a profile photo picker with a round crop hole over your picture. Drag, scroll or use the keyboard to frame your face, zoom with the slider and rotate in quarter turns while three live previews show how it looks in a feed, a chat and a tag. Save cuts a real 256 px round PNG, flies it into the profile card and runs the upload round the avatar before it bursts into sparkles.
how: Press Choose photo or drop a picture on the crop area; it is read on your device.
Drag the photo (or use the arrow keys), zoom with the slider or mouse wheel, and rotate with the turn button or R.
Watch the three live previews, then press Save avatar.
The round cut-out arcs into the profile card, the ring fills as it uploads, then you can download the 256 px PNG.
